notes.title: Patch 0.8.2.5
notes.content: [h2]Hello everyone![/h2][p]After a short vacation, work on the project has resumed with renewed energy. The current demo still has many rough edges, but stability is constantly improving.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/bd24dd21fdeb0eba204f1194c98892690c4762e0.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]NEW:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added a new cargo vehicle (pickup).[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to raid other camps.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new built-in locations (Airfield, Settlement).[/p][/*][*][p]Footstep sounds now always match the terrain.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new section in the options: you can now enable or disable built-in and third-party modifications at will.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/40495561ac90b93342da50ed50bb5a41e54b6f21.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]BOTS:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Improved bot behavior.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly reduced accuracy for all penalty.[/p][/*][*][p]Bot control commands have been restored:[/p][list][*][p]C + LMB (Check area)[/p][/*][*][p]C + RMB (Take position)[/p][/*][*][p]C + MMB (Follow available in the main player interface.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3][b]FIXES:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the character did not experience effects during bleeding.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crosshair centering after weapon collision with obstacles.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug allowing players to jump over any wall if standing with their back to it.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed errors when using vehicle weapons (shooting/reloading).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that made it impossible to build or place mines on roads.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some errors in the location editor.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where terrain would ignore the current biome settings, resulting in incorrect terrain generation.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect armband color depending on the team.[/p][/*][*][p]Placement of mines is now visually clearer.[/p][/*][*][p]Captured enemies no longer participate in capturing locations.[/p][/*][*][p]Injury debuff effects have been adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved map and location generation algorithms, and fixed some bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved optimization.[/p][/*][/list][p][img appreciated![/b][/p][p][b]Dev[/b][/p]

Hi everyone,

[b]IMPORTANT: Playable locations are now UGC![/b]

Over the past two weeks, I’ve been working hard on implementing Workshop support and integrating UGC (User-Generated Content) into the game. It’s been a tough challenge, but the feature is now complete and you can finally extend your game experience with custom-built locations!

[i]There are plans to expand modding capabilities further, that's why this marks an important first step in that direction.[/i]

[img]https://psv4.userapi.com/s/v1/d/qNYWRIE9OQ-P0KRW8t2wSK2iBfIpZsamNnhTW38BVYp9P6stZAhY-PJ21Q9N0_tnADziplEY3RY4TC9M1_Jazn1DFjWqI1tRdNqIldop6yaiTd5H4NNIOw/Raods.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where player session statistics didn’t sync properly.
[*] Fixed the spawn position of boats/watercraft now spawn slightly farther from the harbor.
[*] Fixed a rare bug where leaving a game session could prevent you from connecting to another session.
[*] Fixed incorrect surface based sound effects while driving vehicles.
[*] Fixed a bug where the generated map was smaller than expected.
[*] Corrected incorrect rotation of main camps when map size was too small.
[*] Fixed an issue where road generation could corrupt map buffer data, resulting in sync errors during destruction events.
[*] Resolved Z-fighting issues at road intersections.
[*] Improved road rendering quality.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/675d66199811ea6080fb2b8263e02db7486c2bbf.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Contracts[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed missing penalty fee when failing a task.
[*] Fixed an issue where the intel case didn’t spawn at the crashed helicopter after restarting the map.
[/list]

[h3][b]Mechanics[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] FPV drone now has improved flight controls.
[*] The helicopter HUD is back.
[*] Helicopter flight dynamics were adjusted slightly.
[*] Fixed an issue with actor shock effects.
[*] And more minor fixes under the hood...
[/list]

[h3][b]Workshop[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]The map system now loads custom made locations instead of prebuilt ones.[/b]
[*] Fixed an issue with rotation angles leading to incorrect placement.
[*] Fixed overlapping builder UI when switching between Sandbox and Soldier modes.
[*] Editor tools have been improved.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/c77765265b9676a9ec49aa5072e0b5ecd6144f0a.jpg[/img]

Locations created in the Workshop Editor are now fully functional and can be shared through the Steam Workshop.
Create your location using workshop editor, save it somewhere inside the CAMPS_Mods folder, and run the [b]Outland[/b] server and your custom location will be added to the pool!
[i]You can load and modify existing locations from the [b]CAMPS_Mods/Locations/[/b] folder.[/i]

[list]
[*] [b]Added the ability to build roads inside locations.[/b] [b][i](Hold Left Alt to activate road-building mode.)[/i][/b]
[/list]

[b]Connection types:[/b]
"Main" and "Side" roads try to connect to the main traffic network and are prioritized accordingly.

[b]Exit types:[/b]
- "Internal" roads are used only inside locations.
- "External" roads act as connection points to the rest of the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/8ea4a990d547fb4e68e40db99d61033efdd365f0.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Workshop Access Clarification[/b][/h3]
🛑[b]Demo version users cannot upload or subscribe to Workshop items.[/b]
This is a Steam imposed limitation.

However:
✅ If you're using the Demo version and join a server that uses custom content it will still synchronize to your client. So you can still play on Workshop-based content.

If you'd like full access to Workshop tools and want to support development, consider becoming a Patron on Patreon. Every patron receives a Steam key that currently grants Workshop support.

[h3][b]Known Issue[/b][/h3]
I'm aware of the incorrect weight calculations when the player swaps weapons in the inventory. This issue is already being tracked and will be addressed in an upcoming patch.


Thank you all for your continued support see you in the next patch.
[i](It’s going to be another big one.)[/i]

Dev

[b]Greetings,[/b]

It’s been a rough few weeks of coding and fixing all known issues. Most of the changes are not just about bug fixing, but also about architectural polishing and design. That means the project is becoming more scalable and getting more ready for rapid growth.

I'm happy to announce that most of the critical issues have been fixed in this patch. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/4377f02f85ccbb3a093a3ce364d03f97dc924171.jpg[/img]


[h2][b]Core[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where some textures were weirdly stretched over the whole screen.
[*] Fixed a bug where the map was incorrectly generated for some players who joined later.
[/list]

[h2][b]Outland[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added two new mercenary contracts: Secure the Perimeter and Search the Crash Site.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/90c2e947ce4c9e4339d39aaa2c8e670f8c7764f1.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Camp Builder[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a “Camp Mode” toggle to rotate and move the entire camp.
[*] Added the ability to move and rotate already built structures.
[*] Fixed misleading colors and visual glitches during build mode.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/66e0b35fe2b3bc418f491a3ba3be5492bba60983.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Other[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where tools and ammo were not being used when building inside locations or ordering a vehicle from the factory.
[*] Fixed an issue with delivering the intel case in the Find Intel contract.
[*] Fixed aiming issues on stationary weapons.
[*] Polished tools in Sandbox mode.
[*] Fixed issues with incorrect ragdolls.
[*] Fixed a bug where falling from a boat would prevent a soldier from standing up while it was sinking.
[*] Fixed a bug where attempting to reload a stationary weapon would invoke the function multiple times.
[*] Fixed incorrect placement of cargo inside transports for players who joined later.
[*] The deployment type of weapons is now accessible again and can be purchased from the camp laptop. (The animation isn't ready yet, but logically it's fully functional.)
[*] Fixed a bug where the Territory Control task was completed upon location neutralization, rather than full capture.
[*] Fixed an issue where taking a Bounty Hunter contract would count as successful even if the target was eliminated by others. Now the contract is simply canceled without a penalty fee.
[/list]


I’m slowly but surely working on a new biome. It’s not there yet, but it’s on the deck and step by step getting ready.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/a67965e6c27e61ac53d0c884b3a16e41f385f5fc.jpg[/img]

As always, your feedback and reports are very welcome, join the Discord channel, bug reports can be submitted there as well.

Moving forward,
Dev

[b]Greetings,[/b]

Before we get to the patch notes, I’d like to explain why multiple patches have been uploaded recently without any accompanying notes or explanations.

The reason is simple: during development, it's not uncommon for systems to be reordered or for major backend or frontend changes to occur. Many of these changes make the Steam version incompatible with the current framework version. That’s why hotfixes are often uploaded right away to keep the Steam version functional and running.

As I’m working solo, there’s little spare time to document every step or hotfix, especially while development is moving rapidly. However, as always, I prepare detailed patch notes at the end of each iteration so you won’t miss a thing.

Thank you for your understanding 😊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/b3cbbe5303d6787adecb6e2cead24ea6722892b1.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Fixes:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Credit transactions from users to camps are now secure.
[*] Fixed transport and weapon purchases from camp tents.
[*] Adjusted helicopter flight controls.
[*] Adjusted tank driving controls.
[*] Fixed incorrect aiming position when using scopes.
[*] Fixed a configuration file compatibility issue that caused old users to fail to load any game mode.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing cargo from being stored in vehicles unless they were perfectly upright.
[*] Fixed an issue where soldiers stopped syncing after falling out of a vehicle.
[*] Fixed map generation desync for players who joined a game in progress.
[*] Fixed an issue in Outland mode where purchases didn’t actually consume credits.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/9191aa25e82d924d9d17ff8b3733ff56d885d2be.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]What's new[/b][/h2]

- The CAMP build ability. 
You can now start building and upgrading your personal camp.
To begin, use your resources harvested in Outland to place and expand your base.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/623472c693ad6b69b21ac0c1a28978e6b83d7b62.png[/img]

[h2][b]Economy[/b][/h2]

- Cargo can now be deposited into your camp.
Ammo and cargo crates can be delivered and stored. Simply bring them to the main camp in Outland mode to deposit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/a34d7e946210e002fa3596a67f342a3a5f21554a.png[/img]

[h2][b]Mechanics[/b][/h2]

- Vehicle Crew System: Each crew member now has a specific role within the vehicle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/1702a1f347db50a2d5467a29a468e66830b6d675.jpg[/img]

[b]Other[/b]

- Music references have been updated.

- The main menu map is now deprecated.
In the future, all game scenes will be trimmed from the base project and loaded via embedded or external files, reducing disk space usage.

- The Map Editor is temporarily disabled while editor tools are polished and prepared for Steam Workshop integration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/10f4052927fa5461f92427e79c738525cb44113b.jpg[/img]


Thanks for being interested in the project. You can always support the development by subscribing to the project's Patreon.

Please don’t hesitate to report any bugs you encounter.

Dev

Greetings!

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/72281504baa8b77a7d472ad06a4b6b0d9704b4af.png[/img]

[b]Meta[/b]

> The ability to create a camp is now available to everyone by default and no longer requires a purchase. However, full construction functionality will be available in the next version.

> Financial data and transactions are now secured. (Purchases, balance top-ups, transfers)

[b]Other[/b]

> Fixed GPS and minimap bug.

> Fixed a bug where entering the "Camps" section made it impossible to connect to a server. (The game simply wouldn’t load)

> Fixed an issue with random loot spawning.

> Improved map generation system.

> Fixed bugs and improved the algorithm for generating minimaps.

> Completely reworked the lighting system.

[h2]What’s New[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/13eec092ad88ae1a096c86194be74379497e0f5b.gif[/img]

[b]Animations[/b]

> Completely reworked animation controller and improved animation quality.
This took nearly two and a half months of continuous work. At first, it seemed like a one-week task, but its complexity exceeded all expectations and estimates.
The prolonged release of this patch is due to the unexpectedly complex process of developing the new animation controller.

> Improved shooting system and weapon handling. This also took significant time as a scalable animation system had to be built from scratch.
Currently, only 4 basic weapon types are implemented, but more will be added in future patches along with the expanding arsenal. All necessary models are already prepared.

> Added diagonal sprinting.

> Improved base character stats.

> Aiming systems were completely reworked to enhance realism. (There aren’t many yet, but they’re now better.)

> Improved visual rendering quality.

> Improved bot behavior.

> Slightly improved melee animations and controls, making them more dynamic and responsive.

> Basic animations have reached a decent state, so expect continual improvements in future patches.

[b]Dynamic Day/Night Cycle[/b]

[img]https://psv4.userapi.com/s/v1/d/vqWLLaJmWRpod6VrdhRxdkGDP_3oxsGSGp5KoxlkB_ThRXMi9S9LUyFfmLRa_lfa6The9ZMYLJx8djf7tWnIbLdaMDtItZFWrqqNpkeRJOQpwqR1uC6XPg/DayCycle-1.gif[/img]

> The project no longer relies on preset day/night states like before.
Now the day/night cycle is controlled by in-game time, which the server admin can adjust through the console:
The command time 0-24 sets the current time.
Example:
[i]time 11[/i] sets the time to 11:00 AM.

[b]Optimization[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/cad6d8ceef4512e9781d53bdcb2f88894616a270.png[/img]

> Major optimizations were made to characters, weapons, and vehicles.
Compared to the previous game version, performance has significantly increased, allowing more concurrent players in a session.
While it's still limited to 20 players, performance impact is greatly reduced. As development continues, the plan is to gradually increase this limit.

> Game startup time is now much faster.

> Some processes are now multithreaded, positively impacting performance.
More systems will be parallelized in future patches to provide the smoothest experience possible.

[h2]Patch Summary[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/7d3c718190fb6dc9e4a2addb9fc3c3ebb5446f2e.png[/img]

This patch is intermediate and does not yet move the game to the next version, as it excludes nearly all current game content like weapons and vehicles.

This is because the new character and animation controller require reworking weapon handling and vehicle interaction.
Future patches will reintroduce these systems in a more optimized and polished state.

The most difficult part building an advanced animation controller is now complete. Onward!

If you willing support the project, subscribe to Patreon!

notes.title: Devlog Update
notes.content:
Salute,

This is a news post to keep you updated on the current stage of development and what to expect in the upcoming patch, which I’ve been working tirelessly on.

[previewyoutube=VSt4JsNIx4Y;full][/previewyoutube]

As I mentioned earlier, a lot of time is being dedicated to reworking the character animation controller. The previous one was just a placeholder, and now it’s time to replace and refine it.

Just a very brief overview of what's coming in the new patch... 

[b]Fully reworked player character.[/b]
Characters can now be stripped down to nothing, making looting even more meaningful.
Weapon handling, shooting, and many other control mechanics have been improved, adding realistic behavior and new possibilities.
This was a massive task, but it was planned from the start and primarily enhances the gunplay experience.

[b]Optimization.[/b]
Due to extensive optimization work, the number of simultaneous players per match has been increased to 40 (without performance loss).
This opens up new possibilities for game modes and will definitely be considered during the core game loop integration.

[b]The game will also feature meta-progression and the main game loop. [/b]
More details on this will be shared later.

This is just a brief list of what's coming in the next patch. I can't wait to finish at least an intermediate update.

If you'd like to support the project before release, you can do so on Patreon.

[spoiler] Should an intermediate patch be released when it's ready or push it to the end? [/spoiler]

notes.title: Dev Update – Overhaul & Patch Delay
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I wanted to give you all a quick update on the next patch and why it's taking longer than expected. The main reason for the delay is the massive overhaul of the animation controller. Working hard to improve the system, but as with any complex feature, there have been multiple failed attempts along the way.

That said, development is still moving forward, refining the framework to ensure everything works smoothly, and aiming to show results as soon as possible. Your patience and support mean a lot, can't wait to share the improvements with you.

Stay tuned!

Cheers,
Dev

notes.title: Patch 0.8.1.32201
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello,[/b][/h3]

This is an intermediate patch aimed at ensuring the game works seamlessly with the updated server.

[b]New:[/b]
[list]
[*] The server-side has been significantly improved. This will enable the integration of all planned social tools for communication between players, camps, and event organization.
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where dropping a weapon from the backpack also caused the weapon in hand to be dropped.
[*] Fixed a bug where dropped weapons were invisible, although still visible through the inventory.
[*] Fixed some nuances in bot behavior.
[*] Other minor fixes.
[/list]

As significant effort was put into revamping the server-side, there was less time for the main game. I am now returning to the development of planned improvements and necessary meta elements of the game.

notes.title: Update 0.8.1.2
notes.content:
[b]
[h3]Hello,[/h3]
There hasn't been any news for a while because was unwell and spent most of the week resting. I'm feeling better now and getting back to work.
Over the past weeks, a lot has been done, and numerous changes have been introduced to the game, especially in its meta-systems.

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] The [i]Wilderness [/i]mode has been renamed to [i]Sandbox[/i].
[*] Fixed incorrect visual representation of bot shooting.
[*] In the Sandbox mode (formerly Wilderness), bots now spawn on both sides.
[*] Fixed incorrect location capture visualization progress.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Sandbox map failed to load after switching from another map.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/e99162b5c6b96cf7847226b58b381b53949fc8b7.jpg[/img]

[h2]Meta:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Each tactical point can now be captured, and controlling populated areas allows your team to spawn there.
[*] Controlling technical locations enables the purchase of heavy weaponry.
[*] Controlling warehouses allows you to replenish resources for tactical and technical locations and purchase equipment.
[*] Communication locations provide the ability to track enemy movements.
[*] Resource unloading is now instant and performed with a single click.
[*] Equipment and vehicle orders in the main camp are now purchased with personal funds, while purchases on the map require warehouse resources.
[/list]


[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Significantly reworked the damage system based on weapon caliber.
[*] Major improvements to missile launching and control systems.
[*] Enhanced visual effects.
[*] Kill feed is disabled by default and can be enabled in server settings.
[*] Updated and improved the T72B tank model.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/18f48cd4f99260ff19ecdf89406d11f14754e1f2.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Additions:[/h2]

Added a new vehicle: IFV Mitsubishi 89.
Weapons:
[list]
[*] Oerlikon 35mm KDE.
[*] 2 guided anti-tank missiles Jyu-MAT.
[*] Type 74 machine gun (7.62mm).
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/3b8c7c9c667d44064548339fe4835a315cbb939d.png[/img]

Added a new vehicle: KS-19 100mm anti-aircraft gun, with armor-piercing and fragmentation ammunition. 
(Available in the list of stationary weapons in the construction menu)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/9e0f071c1c2b18fbbc223ed061c347cd70f2bcbb.png[/img]

Added 2 types of jeeps:
[list]
[*] Humvee – a transport jeep for cargo.
[*] Humvee Type 93 SAM – equipped with Type 91 (80mm) infrared-guided surface-to-air missiles.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/6ee5eaa2019b312de194a24421ad3e5eb5e02bb6.png[/img]

Added a new helicopter: AH-1W.
Weapons:
[list]
[*] M197 Gatling gun (20mm).
[*] M272 with AGM-114 Hellfire (180mm).
[*] M260 with Hydra 70 (70mm).
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/e969dda3aec861689b4a572aeb5e668bb05afd49.png[/img]

Numerous other minor fixes and improvements.

[h2]Next Steps:[/h2]
For now, work on vehicles and related mechanics will be paused (except for the fact that another tank will be added in future patches). I plan to focus on developing meta-systems. This means that in the upcoming patches, you can expect:
[list]
[*] Soldier progression systems.
[*] Expanded base-building capabilities.
[*] Integration of all planned tools for these systems.
[/list]

I hope to implement everything as envisioned.
Thank you to everyone who continues to support me and the project, reporting the issues, you're the best!
[/b]

notes.title: Patch 0.8.1.03181320
notes.content:

notes.title: Patch 0.8.1.02981655
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone,[/h3]
It’s been a while since any detailed news, so it’s time to share some updates. 
Let’s start with some good news and summarize the results of the recent Next Fest on Steam. It’s safe to say that this was the best thing that has happened to the project among all events so far.

There are a few reasons for this. Firstly, the project was more prepared for the festival, and secondly, the presentation was slightly improved, giving players a clearer understanding of what kind of game they will be dealing with.

Overall, the project showed solid results compared to previous festivals. It may not be reaching for the stars yet, but there are still 2 years until the release. Could say that after so many years of prototyping, the project's direction is now fully set.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/c4a6cfdb0bbfb3b9f406c5a8f6142b0c5761d19a.png[/img]

Now, for some slightly unpleasant news. Right after the festival, the server was attacked by intruders :beetle:. 
It wasn’t just a regular DDoS aimed at taking down the server, but an actual hacking attempt, seemingly using brute force. I don’t personally understand the motive behind this, but it did disrupt the development process a bit as had to divert resources to strengthen security. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/33e49a6751e0a87754beb50b9ef154d45d5f1f5f.png[/img]

[h2]What's new in the patch:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a critical bug that prevented players from joining other servers after leaving the current one.
[*] Added a new type of contract and a new type of story structure in Wilderness mode.
[*] Now, when a "Bounty Hunter" contract is taken against you, you receive a counter-passive contract, "Defensive Stence." If the hunter dies before reaching you, you receive their reward.
[*] Bullet holes now stay on vehicles rather than floating in the air.
[*] The sandbox mode interface has been reworked and is now divided into access levels.
[*] Battle results are now correctly displayed at the end of the match.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the use of the bodycam in spectator mode.
[*] Minor interface layout adjustments.
[*] Numerous small bugs have been fixed.
[*] Slight optimization improvements.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/a79cc1f920ee760d34e240dd4e7a874c820eab14.png[/img]

Currently, I'm working on developing all the necessary tools for team play (the CAMPS section). Therefore, from time to time, there may be disconnections from the server, as well as issues with connecting to and launching the game. [b]I will do my best to prevent this, but just in case, I’m warning you that it might happen.[/b]

So, if you encounter connection problems, I ask for your understanding, as this is an alpha version, and there is still a lot of work ahead.

[i]During this year, the cost of in-game purchases will remain at zero so that everyone has the opportunity to familiarize themselves with all the mechanics.[/i]

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Update 0.8.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/ba583d0c14947725109b837cd00b1a12bc7df3e3.png[/img]
[b]Hello everyone,[/b]

Development is moving forward, and with each step, we're becoming more confident. The project has now moved to a new version 0.8.1.x. It's still an early alpha, and the product is still raw, but it’s becoming increasingly stable and viable.

[h3]What’s new in patch 0.8.1:[/h3]

[b]Important changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] The project now fully utilizes in-game resources, allowing anyone to create their own maps and modify existing ones. To get acquainted with the basic tools, go to Map Builder and load the "Manilovka" file from the CAMPS_Maps folder. (This is the main folder for storing all loaded game maps.) 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/91bba9ee67ac00639bf6a192d3aadb3769479d3a.png[/img]

[*] In the current game version, Map Builder includes three biomes and nearly five hundred objects, ranging from civilian to industrial. (The interface overhaul and object sorting will come in future updates.)
[/list]

[h3]Important:[/h3] [b]If you want to spawn as a player in Map Builder, simply press Left Shift + P. Pressing it again will return you to edit mode.[/b]


Starting with this patch, the project smoothly transitions from prototype mode to a vertical slice. The game is divided into several gameplay loops: Solo/Co-op and Team/Base Building.

[h3]Solo/Co-op Cycle (Wilderness)[/h3]
[list]
[*] In this mode, you have the opportunity to increase your balance by completing contracts in wilderness areas (randomly generated maps). Other mercenaries may also be present on the map at the same time.
[/list]

[h3]Team/Base Building Cycle (CAMPS)[/h3]
[list]
[*] This mode opens up additional gameplay possibilities where you can participate in ranked battles against other teams, develop your camp, and grow your character.
[/list]

[b]Of course, not all planned elements are implemented yet, but they will be added in future updates.[/b]

notes.title: CAMPS at Gamescom and Patch 0.8.0.82461136
notes.content:
[b]New Patch 0.8.0.82461136[/b]

[b]Hello everyone,[/b]

I have some updates to share. 

:laptop: This time, the main changes involve the so-called Backend. (For those who aren't familiar, this is the part of the game responsible for saving all player information and managing the connections between them).
[list]
[*] [b]The entire backend code has been completely rewritten from the old PHP to the more modern Node.js. [/b]By utilizing Node.js, all procedures now work asynchronously and through a pooling system, which has optimized the server-side performance. At this stage of development, this will help handle a much larger number of concurrent users.
[/list] 

:fix: Other fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed logical errors when switching modes after a game ends.
[*] Heavy vehicles have been reintroduced to the project, currently in limited numbers, but the rest will be gradually added. (You can test them by ordering them at the transport depot).
[*] Turret controls on combat vehicles have been completely rewritten.
[*] Added the first iteration of a new, and likely future primary, mode, currently named "Domination".
[*] The number of team kills and "revives" are now saved in the stats.
[*] Optimized character shadow rendering.
[*] Fixed a bug where operation points were not awarded to teams if 200 was selected.
[*] Fixed incorrect distance indicators on the mortar.
[*] Fixed grenade throws. And many other small fixes.
[/list] 

:flame: [b]At the end of August, I represented CAMPS at Gamescom 2024 and made a short compilation from a walk through the B2C section. [/b]
Youtube short link:
[url=https://youtube.com/shorts/8rpQ7erRr7k]https://youtube.com/shorts/8rpQ7erRr7k[/url]

I won't remind you that thumbs up help Steam's algorithms understand that the game is "alive".

notes.title: Patch 0.8.0.62121555
notes.content:
The game is rapidly developing, happy to announce a new patch. By the way, there are many more updates on the Discord server.

[h1][b]CORE[/b][/h1]

[b]THE MOST IMPORTANT[/b]
- Finally, the game scales have been put in order.
All this time, the project had a fundamental error from the days when improperly scaled assets were used (not my fault, but I didn't notice). Now all objects and distances between them correspond to real sizes. This has led to distances almost doubling and has affected shooting and the feeling of distances compared to how it was (At first, it may seem unusual).

[h1][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h1]

- The map now has "Cache" containers, which are active in all modes except Trophy Hunter. You can store loot in these containers, and at the end of the game, it is automatically saved to your personal collection. (Marked on the minimap as [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/2c472e6953c80a938be5dfe95b9168502bbf65cb.png[/img])
- If your drone remains intact until the end of the game, it returns to your personal storage.
- Fixed the absence of hit indication on one-shots.
- Fixed incorrect display of friend/foe and points of interest when changing teams.
- Mushrooms now restore health throughout the entire duration of the effect.

[h1][b]AI[/b][/h1]

- Bots are added to the game by default. To add bots, enter "addbot" in the console.
- Bot names are now permanent and do not change during the session.
- Killing bots now also deducts tickets from the team.
- Fixed a bug where bot kills were not counted in the host player's statistics.
- Fixed a bug where bots did not appear in match results.
- Fixed a bug where bots did not take damage from fire.
- Fixed a bug where bot rotation after map reload worked incorrectly.
- Fixed a bug where bots did not deal damage when shooting with a crossbow or firearms.
- Bots now engage in firefights more realistically and can really give you a hard time.
+ Many other fixes and changes.

I don't need to remind you that your thumbs up help the project—you already know that.

notes.title: CAMPS Builder Revealed
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/02b239146112cd74571e611e77aa600850d0a20d.png[/img]

[b]Hello everyone![/b]
Here's a brief overview of the new patch 0.8.0.413903

[b]Fixes:[/b]
- Fixed inconveniences in using the text chat.
- Fixed a bug where in Trophy Hunter mode, a vehicle passenger would hang in the air when evacuated by another player.
- Slightly improved the Sandbox mode interface.
- In Sandbox mode, bots and player now spawn where the camera is looking.

Recently, many have asked if CAMPS will be more like Escape from Tarkov or Squad? 

Therefore, I think it's worth noting again that the main inspirations for the project were ARMA (Operation FlashPoint) and Red Orchestra. EFT or Squad have interesting solutions that can complement the project but are not the primary references.

[b]CAMPS[/b] is a military sandbox aiming to incorporate the best and fix the worst. And like any respectable sandbox, in the new patch want to introduce you to the trial version of [b]CAMPS Builder.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/f896acc70b884acf9ad608fdd28a1b553a3aac3d.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=KvOTJKEJ8Rw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b]What is CAMPS Builder.[/b][/h1]

It's a powerful and unique map/scenario editor (mentioned before), available not as a separate application but embedded into the game and operating on its resources. To say I was exhausted making it is an understatement. Thanks to everyone who helped debug the editor over the past week, it wasn't easy, but the crash reasons were found and fixed.

I've been working on the tools for a long time, and now that the stable version is ready, I will be glad if you find the time to try it out.

[b]What is available in the trial version:[/b]
- 2 biomes available: "Taiga" and "Savanna"
- Landscape generator.
- Vegetation generator.
- Lighting settings.
- Water settings.
- Building construction.
- Map saving/loading.

[h1][b]What will be added:[/b][/h1]
- Road construction.
- Fence construction.
- Advanced settings for building houses and working with the environment.
- Tools for landscape design.
- Tools for scenario creation.

[h1][b]What's happening now:[/b][/h1]
- Adding DLSS and FSR support.
- Optimizing the server build size.
- Optimizing the editor.
- Bringing heavy machinery back into the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/07be86dde747eafd118440cfd53981282ec30b22.png[/img]

Due to this, tests are postponed for a while, but the next one will include heavy machinery. 
(All screenshots are taken in the editor mode)
Share your feedback on the Map Builder.

Stay tuned.

notes.title: Weekly Patch Review
notes.content:
Hi there,

Thanks to everyone who has reported issues. Your feedback is invaluable in helping shape the game and resolve problems.

Here is a summary of this week's hotfixes:

[h1]Game Logic[/h1]
- SCA (Scavenger) mode renamed to TH (Trophy Hunter).
- Sound settings corrected.
- Fixed a bug where the game continued even if one of the teams ran out of tickets.
- Fixed a bug with infinite clicking of melee attack if a weapon is held.
- Fixed a bug where a player could not respawn after exploding in a vehicle in Trophy Hunter mode.
- Fixed chest camera, now unable to switch to deceased teammates.
- Fixed flickering of marker lights when the vehicle is stationary.
- Fixed a bug with the pink drone.
- A road has been added to the "Garages" location on the "Manilovka" map.
- Some other cosmetic fixes.

[h1]Network[/h1]
- Added text chat (Global, Team, Private). Example of sending a private message: "37 Wait, I'm coming" (Where 37 is the player ID).
- Fixed a bug in DM mode on the dedicated server where only one match was played before the server disappeared from the list.
- Fixed a bug when creating your own server after leaving another server.
- Fixed all errors with vehicle synchronization that caused the vehicles to jerk.

[h1]UI[/h1]
- When attempting to switch teams, there is now a warning about the inability to switch if the player's soldier is alive.
- Fixed an issue where team tickets could be displayed incorrectly.

[h1]Weaponry[/h1]
- Fixed incorrect zeroing on all pistols.

[h1]AI[/h1]
- Fixed a bug with the spawning of bots on a dedicated server when they appeared without weapons and equipment.
- Fixed some errors related to bot behavior (stopped killing themselves and shooting from behind).
- Bots are now automatically added to the game in TH (6 on the map) and DM (3 on location).


Solution to optimize server performance was founded, will conduct tests this weekend. If successful, more servers will be available next week.

Cheers!

notes.title: CAMPS: Official Demo Gameplay Trailer
notes.content:
[h1]Some Thrilling News to Share![/h1]

[previewyoutube=zEmiqyo10XQ;full][/previewyoutube]

What the demo includes:

[h1][b]1. The Bots are Deployed.[/b][/h1]

This update is part of ongoing effort to maintain dynamic gameplay, even in the absence of players. 
AI-driven opponents will provide an opportunity to test your skills and shooting mechanics. The bots are currently quite simple, but there are many plans to enhance their tactical and fighting abilities in the future. 
Additionally, bots automatically respawn, so there's no need to manually add them each time one is defeated—just wait for them to respawn.

For more information on controlling the bots via the in-game console, visit discussion page: [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2882560/discussions/0/7179373376270374465/]Console commands[/url][/b]

[h1][b]2. Sandbox Tools Available for Testing.[/b][/h1]

This is the initial implementation of sandbox tools. You can access the tool panel by pressing Left Shift+P.

Note: These tools are available on the Test Range map only or to players with admin rights.

[b]Basic Functionality:[/b]
The sandbox tools allow players to control day conditions, spawn bots, vehicles, and items. They also include access to cinematic tools, which can be used to film your future in-game highlights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/58afb77691833a3f13f9071e2be6ab62f0c2b48c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931964/2bbabc5c1a46b5c64d956edda50ba57f27a4e670.png[/img]

[h1][b]3. Until Dawn Period.[/b][/h1]

The "Until Dawn Period" refers to the timeframe from [b]Now[/b] until the [b]Early Access[/b] stage begins. During this period, each player have access to save the loot as original game owners. All items you loot will be stored and loaded. Once the game transitions to the Early Access stage, the Demo version will then no longer support the storage of looted items or personal progression upon exit.

[h1][b]4. Extermination Game Mode Spotlight.[/b][/h1]

Extermination mode is currently the highlight of CAMPS. In this game mode, players are divided into Attackers and Defenders. The Defenders must hide and strive to survive, while the Attackers are tasked with finding and eliminating all Defenders before time runs out.

A key feature of Extermination mode is that each player has only one life per round. Players may be revived, but they cannot respawn until the next round begins.

For more details about the win/lose conditions, please visit: [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2882560/discussions/0/4291440749282771386/]CAMPS Game Modes[/url][/b].


Feel free to test the game modes with your friends and share your thoughts in the discussions!

Your Developer[/b]

notes.title: CAMPS Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
As the creator behind CAMPS, I am thrilled to announce the launch of our demo on Steam today. 
This game is the culmination of intense dedication to crafting a deeply engaging military sandbox experience that blends strategic decision-making with immersive team-oriented gameplay.

I invite you, the community, to participate in OBT and dive into various operations that require sharp teamwork. 

[h1][b]What is CAMPS Demo.[/b][/h1]
[b]
The demo includes all the features that the original game will offer. The only difference is that in the demo, you cannot save your in-game progress and looted items. However, before the game becomes available in early access, the demo version will allow you to save your progress and items. Once the game reaches the early access stage, the demo will revert to its original functionality as intended.[/b]

[h1][b]What This Demo Includes[/b][/h1]

In this demo, you can try out all in-game mechanics as well as play deathmatch and team deathmatch with others. The game allows you to host your own servers, join your Steam friends' sessions, or invite them. 
[i]New game modes, maps and content will be added in the nearest future.[/i]

Please share your gameplay experiences, and suggestions in Steam Community Hub.
For support and bug reports, visit the [b][url=https://discord.gg/8ATagM3mcG]Discord[/url][/b] or contact us directly through[b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2882560/discussions/]Community Hub[/url][/b].
